# Security assessment (Rudolf S.)

Threat models and reviews code and infrastructure for vulnerabilities.

- Source: https://github.com/rsmdt/the-startup
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsmdt/the-startup/main/plugins/team/skills/quality/security-assessment/SKILL.md
- Author: Rudolf S.
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/security-assessment-rudolf-s-d4d3ab03

Claude gathers context on the target, models threats with STRIDE, reviews code against OWASP patterns, assesses infrastructure, and reports findings by severity with location, impact and a fix. Focus areas include authentication, authorization, input handling and secrets. Checklists and reference material ship with the skill.

**Try asking:**
- "Run a security assessment on our auth module"
- "Threat model this new file upload feature"
- "Review the API gateway config for security issues"
